components.name: Run action
components.description: The single bright action at the end of run setup.

components.name: Selected source choice
components.description: A selected source tile within the three-column choice grid.
components.css: .ds-source-choice{min-width:115px;text-align:left;padding:12px 9px;border:1px solid #d8ee6b;border-radius:9px;background:#40543d;color:#f0eee4;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s,transform .18s,border-color .18s}.ds-source-choice svg{display:block;width:22px;height:26px;fill:none;stroke:#d8ee6b;stroke-width:1.8}.ds-source-choice strong,.ds-source-choice small{display:block;white-space:nowrap;font-family:'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif}.ds-source-choice strong{font-size:11px}.ds-source-choice small{font-size:10px;color:#b3c2b2;margin-top:5px}.ds-source-choice:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}.ds-source-choice:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #d6f167;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Model search
components.description: Searches served or hosted models inside the dark setup panel.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10.8" cy="10.8" r="6.8"/><path d="m16 16 5 5"/></svg><input aria-label="Filter models" placeholder="Filter served models" /></label>

components.name: Model selection row
components.description: A model row with the selected radio treatment and a compact context label.
components.css: .ds-model-row{min-height:54px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 10px;background:#40543d;color:#f4f0e6;border:1px solid #596b5c;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif}.ds-model-row:hover{background:#40543d}.ds-model-row:focus-within{outline:3px solid #d6f167;outline-offset:3px}.ds-model-row input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px}.ds-model-row i{width:14px;height:14px;border:4px solid #d8ee6b;border-radius:50%;flex:none}.ds-model-row span{min-width:0;flex:1}.ds-model-row strong,.ds-model-row small{display:block;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-model-row strong{font-size:12px}.ds-model-row small{font:10px 'JetBrains Mono Variable',monospace;color:#b3c2b2;margin-top:4px}.ds-model-row em{font:9px 'JetBrains Mono Variable',monospace;color:#b3c2b2;font-style:normal;white-space:nowrap}

components.name: Scorecard
components.description: A paper-like task matrix with explicit outcome words and measured columns.
components.css: .ds-scorecard{max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid #d0d5c4;border-radius:8px;background:#fbfaf2;color:#18231a}.ds-scorecard table{border-collapse:collapse;min-width:680px;width:100%}.ds-scorecard th,.ds-scorecard td{text-align:left;padding:14px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #d0d5c4}.ds-scorecard thead th{font:700 9px 'JetBrains Mono Variable',monospace;color:#596b5c;background:#fbfaf2}.ds-scorecard tbody th{padding-left:14px}.ds-scorecard tbody th strong{display:block;font:700 11px 'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif}.ds-scorecard tbody th small{display:block;font:10px 'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif;color:#596b5c;margin-top:4px}.ds-scorecard tbody td{font:700 10px 'JetBrains Mono Variable',monospace;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-scorecard .ds-pass{color:#366e37;font-weight:800}

components.name: Paid run guard
components.description: A separate warm zone around hosted-run spending confirmation.
components.html:
$ Paid run guard

Confirm the active workspace cap before this hosted run.
components.css: .ds-paid{max-width:320px;background:#362f26;border:1px solid #896c48;border-radius:10px;padding:16px;color:#f4f0e6;font-family:'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif}.ds-paid h3{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin:0;color:#ffe4ac;font-size:13px}.ds-paid h3 span{width:23px;height:23px;border:1px solid #ddb871;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center}.ds-paid p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#eed5ad}.ds-paid label{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;margin-top:12px}.ds-paid input{display:block;width:100%;margin-top:6px;border:1px solid #a88b61;background:#211f1a;color:#ffe4ac;padding:9px;border-radius:6px;font:inherit;box-sizing:border-box}.ds-paid input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #d6f167;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Run detail panel
components.description: A pale inset record of the exact run identity and settings.
components.css: .ds-run-detail{max-width:420px;background:#e5ead9;border:1px solid #d0d5c4;border-radius:9px;padding:17px 18px;color:#18231a}.ds-run-detail h3{font:800 18px 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable',sans-serif;margin:0 0 14px}.ds-run-detail dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:13px 20px;margin:0}.ds-run-detail dt{font:700 9px 'JetBrains Mono Variable',monospace;color:#596b5c;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}.ds-run-detail dd{font:11px/1.4 'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif;margin:4px 0 0;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}@media(max-width:620px){.ds-run-detail dl{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

narrative.overview:
The console pairs a dark control surface with a warm paper report surface. Lime marks active work, while the paper area keeps task outcomes and measurements easy to scan. A compact header shows the workspace name and live counts, placing controls and results near the top of the page.

This is the first code-led visual direction, not an owner-approved brand identity. Its reusable character is a bright, instrument-like working surface with visible run identity and task-level evidence. The owner’s direction is “form and function, not sacrificing one for another”: visual character should serve the task without taking space from it.
keyCharacteristics: Dark operation area beside a cream result sheet.
Strong display type for short declarations; compact monospace for measurements and system labels.
Lime for selection and action; coral and green for distinct result meanings.
Thin boundaries and surface tone carry most of the hierarchy.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Reserve lime for active work, selection, and the main action; keep outcome words explicit so color never carries the result alone.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Put exact values in a mono treatment near the task or run they describe; keep explanatory prose in DM Sans.

rules.name: The Flat Record Rule
rules.body: Keep report data on the cream plane; use borders and spacing to separate rows before adding lift.

dos: Do give run setup and task evidence distinct dark and light surfaces.
Do show outcome words alongside pass and miss colors.
Do keep long identifiers and wide result tables contained within their component boundaries.
Do use the established 1350px, 900px, and 620px transitions when extending this console shell.
donts: Don't add a large decorative hero above the run controls and results.
Don't imply model superiority from a tiny smoke suite.
Don't rely on shadows to structure the report surface.
